newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize steady in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize steady in slow trade.

text.p: Argentine cash maize was mainly steady in slow trade midsession at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, traders said.

The FAS elevator maize price in Buenos Aires was steady at $112. Port congestion means exporters are not being pushed to buy and supply was short. Spot soybeans firmed $4 in Rosario to $299 in tight trade, with prices squeezed higher by a firm Chicago. Sunflower seed was steady to firmer in tight trade, with good demand from crushers to meet oil sales. Sunflower seed rose $4 in Quequen to $219.
